levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The script is missing one or more of the three parts (problem, context, need) or is too vague to act on.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The script clearly includes all three parts.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The script is concise enough to say quickly under pressure, not just complete on paper.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The revised script is nearly unchanged from the first attempt despite feedback being given.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The revised script reflects specific feedback.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner can explain specifically why the revision is clearer or faster, not just that something changed.

lookFors: No audio or video recording exists anywhere for this task.
The final script contains all three parts (problem, context, need) in clear, short sentences.
Nothing in the response suggests a real emergency service was contacted as part of this drill.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
